clusters.label: Direct bandgap
clusters.definition: An electronic band gap whose valence-band maximum and conduction-band minimum occur at the same crystal momentum.
clusters.reason: All describe the same calculated band-gap concept; material differences and pressure-induced changes remain claim-specific.

clusters.label: Photocatalytic water splitting
clusters.definition: Light-driven catalytic splitting of water.
clusters.reason: All name the same proposed application, supported by different material-specific calculations.

clusters.label: AC conductivity
clusters.definition: Electrical conductivity in response to an alternating electrical excitation.
clusters.reason: Both concern frequency-dependent electrical conductivity; temperature, direction and composition qualify the individual claims.

clusters.label: Small-polaron conduction
clusters.definition: Charge transport mediated by small polarons.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly identify the small-polaron mechanism. The additional ionic contribution in one material does not redefine that mechanism.

clusters.label: Hopping conduction
clusters.definition: Electrical conduction through carrier hopping between localized sites.
clusters.reason: Both identify hopping conduction without assigning a narrower common subtype.

clusters.label: Lattice constants
clusters.definition: Parameters specifying the dimensions of a crystal unit cell.
clusters.reason: All denote the same structural quantity; filler effects, transport effects and computational optimization remain attached to their claims.

clusters.label: Increasing dopant ionic radius
clusters.definition: An increase in the ionic radius of the dopant species across a substitution series.
clusters.reason: All denote the same directional change in a dopant property. Dopant identities and the different resulting transport trends remain claim-specific.

unresolved.reason: “Good” has no supplied quantitative criterion, and the selected energy range is unspecified; an equivalent performance category cannot be established.
The favorable optical-conductivity assessment has no supplied threshold or spectral range establishing equivalence to the other assessment.

clusters.label: Film morphology
clusters.definition: The physical form and structural organization of a film.
clusters.reason: Each label denotes the morphological property of a film, without naming a particular morphology. Their film compositions and preservation or modification claims remain distinct.

clusters.label: Solar cells
clusters.definition: Devices for converting incident sunlight into electrical energy.
clusters.reason: Both name the same application class, with suitability proposed for different compositions.

clusters.label: CuCrSe2
clusters.definition: The compound with composition CuCrSe2.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly identify the same compound; ordered and superionic states qualify the reported properties rather than changing the material label.

clusters.label: Hole conduction
clusters.definition: Electrical charge transport by holes.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly identify hole-mediated conduction; different hosts and relative contributions do not change the carrier-defined process.

clusters.label: Oxygen ionic conductivity
clusters.definition: The electrical conductivity contribution from oxygen-ion transport.
clusters.reason: Both denote the same species-specific ionic conductivity. Interstitial concentration and iron incorporation describe separate influences on it.

clusters.label: p-Type electronic conduction
clusters.definition: Electronic conduction carried by holes.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly denote p-type electronic transport. The separately stated small-polaron mechanism characterizes one claim without narrowing the shared label.

clusters.label: Bipolar conduction
clusters.definition: Electrical conduction involving both electron and hole carriers.
clusters.reason: Both identify the same transport process; its suppression and its compensation of thermopower are separate consequences.

clusters.label: Mg2Si
clusters.definition: The compound with composition Mg2Si.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly refer to Mg2Si. The second study separately identifies Y-containing compositions, so its Mg2Si node is not a Y-doped sample.

clusters.label: Density
clusters.definition: Material mass per unit volume.
clusters.reason: The molar-volume and physical-property contexts support material density in both cases, with no distinct density subtype specified.

clusters.label: Topological charges at neutral–ionic domain boundaries
clusters.definition: Topological charges carried by mobile neutral–ionic dielectric–ferroelectric domain boundaries in the quasi-one-dimensional organic material.
clusters.reason: The evidence explicitly identifies the charge-bearing boundaries and their dimensional context.

unresolved.reason: The evidence associates topological charges with a pressure-induced ionic-neutral transition but does not identify their charge-bearing structure sufficiently to establish equivalence to the specified domain-boundary charges.

clusters.label: LiMgN
clusters.definition: The half-Heusler compound with composition LiMgN.
clusters.reason: Explicitly defined composition containing Mg, distinct from LiZnN despite shared structural and electronic classifications.

clusters.label: LiZnN
clusters.definition: The half-Heusler compound with composition LiZnN.
clusters.reason: Explicitly defined composition containing Zn, distinct from LiMgN.

clusters.label: Photovoltaic effect
clusters.definition: The generation of an electrical voltage or current through photoexcited charge carriers.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly identify the photovoltaic mechanism and distinguish its contribution from thermoelectric or photothermoelectric effects.
